name: Gemma
purpose: Gemma aims to democratize access to advanced AI capabilities by providing powerful, open-access LLMs for developers and researchers. This fosters innovation and enables deployment across diverse hardware, including on-device applications, promoting a deeper understanding of LLM systems.
coreComponents: Advanced Attention Mechanisms (e.g., Multi-Query, Grouped-Query, Mixture-of-Experts)
keyCapabilities: Code generation, completion, and chat assistance
Reasoning and problem-solving across various domains
Function calling and structured tool use for agentic workflows
integrations: Keras, PyTorch, and JAX machine learning frameworks
Google Cloud (Vertex AI, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Run)
NVIDIA GPUs and developer tools (e.g., NeMo, TensorRT-LLM)
useCases: Building conversational AI assistants and chatbots
Generating diverse content such as emails, advertising copy, and creative text
On-device AI applications for privacy-first document processing and voice assistants
